rv.q: Brainiac Live remains an outstanding example of educational theatre.
It truly holds up to its Olivier-winning quality expectations, and is definitely worth catching while it is in the West End this summer.
Brainiac Live is energetic, funny and genuinely impressive.
It is a thrilling, high-octane summer treat that makes science unforgettably fun.
This live adaptation successfully captures that same spirit, bringing the controlled chaos and infectious enthusiasm of the television series into the theatre.

cn.t: Critics praise this Olivier Award-winning family show for its explosive energy and skillful blend of education with entertainment, delivering fast-paced scientific mayhem that engages both children and adults alike.
